resources.string: Please review how the app connects to services, stores data, and requests permissions.
NeriPlayer plays content from platforms you choose to access. It does not host media files.
Data stays on your device by default
Settings, history, download records, and local diagnostics stay on-device and are not used for advertising or profiling.
Selected data is sent only after you enable GitHub, WebDAV, or a self-hosted service.
Set the essentials in a few steps. Every optional choice can be changed later.
The next screens will use this language.
Connect the ones you use most so it is easier to find what you want.
You can leave this unconnected for now and sign in or import Cookies later in settings.
Without a signed-in platform, search, playlists, and playback resources may be restricted. You can go back and connect one now, or continue and sign in later from settings.
Back up playlists to your own private GitHub repository.
GitHub sync is optional too, and you can finish it later in settings.
Choose GitHub or WebDAV automatic sync, or sync manually whenever you want.
GitHub and WebDAV are optional services. Configure automatic sync for each one separately while keeping control of your data.
Tune UI scale, theme, and wallpaper while this setup page reflects the result.
Preview is about %1$d%% right now. Drag to see the change.
After you choose an image, its background, blur, and opacity apply across this setup page immediately.
Enable this after choosing a background image. It is not needed without one.
A background image is selected. This adds fuller live glass blur to the top bar, bottom bar, and settings cards.

You just chose a background image. Enhanced Advanced Blur blends the image with interface surfaces more naturally, but uses more rendering resources. Allowing it enables the setting immediately; you can also leave it off.
After the preference steps, the learning guide will show you easy-to-miss feature entry points.
Automatic fallback is off by default. It only tries another source after you confirm it here.
Includes NetEase source switching and matched local audio. When off, only the original source is used.
One fallback option is already enabled in settings. Confirming will enable both together.
It only applies when the original source fails or is restricted, and does not change the normal preferred source.

When enabled, the app may match the song from another platform or use a matching local audio file. Confirm that you have the lawful right to use that content; the app cannot determine copyright or licensing for you.

When the original source is unavailable, the app may automatically try another platform source or a matching local file. Confirm that you understand this behavior and will verify your own usage rights.
The system prompt appears only after you choose it. You can keep going without granting it.
Show the current track and media controls in notifications and on the lock screen.
This Android version does not require a separate notification permission; playback notifications are managed by the system.
Scan and play audio files on this device. Online playback and downloads still work without it.
You can skip either permission and change it later from the related feature or system settings.
Declining notification permission may affect playback, including lock-screen controls and playback status. NeriPlayer will not send unrelated push notifications. Grant notification permission now?

Playback notifications are used only for the current track, progress, pause/resume, previous/next, and other media controls. They also make background playback and lock-screen controls more reliable. The app will not use this permission for news, ads, or unrelated pushes. Without it, the system may hide playback status and some devices may limit background playback. Choose based on your needs.
Choose the control size and placement. The preview updates immediately.
Last night the east wind blew
It feels like a river flowing east
How much sorrow can the heart hold
The river keeps its quiet glow
Playback controls across the Now Playing screen use this size.
Place controls lower, at the bottom, or pin both controls and progress at the bottom.
This changes lyrics on the Now Playing cover only. The lyrics page has its own size.
Tune cover and full lyrics page text separately, with a live preview for each.
This mirrors the song header, centered scrolling lyrics, and playback controls from the real lyrics page.
Only changes the full lyrics page. The cover page lyric size stays independent.
Using a different size from the cover page can make the page transition feel less natural.
Different control sizes on the lyrics and cover pages may make the transition look uneven. Continue with this size?
One banana leaf, one quiet ache
Keep the one before your eyes
Where can longing find its name
Let the new words meet the wine
These entry points help you find common features faster before you start using the app.
Tap the mini player to open Now Playing, then swipe between the cover and lyrics pages.
The lyrics page uses advanced lyrics by default, with line scrolling, translations, and long-press sharing.
Long-press a song in a playlist to enter multi-select, then choose more songs for batch play, favorite, delete, or export.
Manage download tasks, file locations, and local imports in settings. Permissions are requested only when needed.
Configure GitHub and WebDAV separately. Their automatic sync switches are independent.
Create a room from playback or settings to share tracks, progress, and playback modes with friends.
Open the queue from Now Playing to inspect tracks, drag to reorder, and use playback modes or the sleep timer.

NeriPlayer is a local-first audio and video player for collecting and playing third-party content you choose to access. The app does not host, upload, or distribute media files. Online playback, search, sign-in, and downloads connect directly to the relevant platform or service you select.
Copyright and related rights in playable content belong to the original creators, rightsholders, or platforms.
You are responsible for confirming that content you access, download, share, or use has a lawful source and the necessary permissions.
Do not use the app to infringe third-party content, trademarks, privacy, or other lawful rights.
Risks arising from your access, download, sharing, or distribution are your responsibility under applicable law.
Platform sign-in, Cookies, playback URLs, and metadata are subject to the terms and privacy policies of the relevant third-party platforms.
Third-party availability, content, APIs, and regional restrictions can change at any time and are not guaranteed by the app.
Before enabling a third-party account or self-hosted service, review and accept its terms and privacy policy yourself.
Playback history, favorites, settings, download tasks, and local diagnostics are stored on your device by default.
Local diagnostics are not uploaded automatically. Relevant data leaves the device only when you export, share, or configure sync yourself.
GitHub, WebDAV, and self-hosted Listen Together services are optional. After you enable them, selected sync data is sent to the service you configure.
Notification permission shows playback status and media controls. Most playback features still work if you decline it.
Local music permission is used only to scan and play audio files on your device. Online playback and downloads do not require it.
Permissions or system settings for floating lyrics, Bluetooth, and background playback are requested only when you enable the corresponding feature.
You can skip non-essential permissions and change them later from the related feature or system settings.
This version does not include third-party advertising, behavioral analytics, or profiling SDKs.
Third-party platforms and sync services you configure may process access logs or account data under their own policies.
Downloads are stored in the local location you choose. The app does not upload them to developer-controlled content servers.
Actions involving accounts, credentials, or private data are initiated by you. Keep your device and sync-service accounts secure.
The update date is shown at the top of this page and this notice may change with app features or data handling.
The app is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis, with no promise of uninterrupted, error-free, or purpose-specific operation.

These limitations do not affect rights that applicable law does not allow to be excluded or limited.
You must comply with the laws of your location and the terms of services you use. Content, platforms, and features may be unavailable because of region, network, account status, or platform policy.
This notice may be updated for feature, data-handling, or legal changes. The revised version will appear in the app; please read it again before continuing to use it.
By continuing, you confirm that you have read and understood this notice. If you do not agree, stop using the app and its related features.
